title: Infrared spectrum of ethanoic acid
caption: The very broad O–H absorption of a carboxylic acid (2500–3000 cm⁻¹, broadened by hydrogen bonding) together with a sharp C=O near 1710 cm⁻¹ identifies the –COOH group. Below 1500 cm⁻¹ is the fingerprint region.
alt: Transmittance against wavenumber: a very broad dip from about 2500 to 3300, a strong sharp dip at about 1710 and a dip near 1290.
description: C–O near 1290 cm⁻¹, in the fingerprint region.
